stepExplanation:
Converting units:
- Q = 8 μC = 8 × 10⁻⁶ C
- r = 40 cm = 0.40 m

Calculating electric field:
$$E = \frac{kQ}{r^2} = \frac{(9 \times 10^9)(8 \times 10^{-6})}{(0.40)^2}$$
$$E = \frac{72000}{0.16} = 450000 \text{ N/C} = 4.5 \times 10^5 \text{ N/C}$$
stepBody: Convert units and apply E = kQ/r². Give your answer in N/C.
